basis: all_local_exterior_correspondence_profiles.json, complete finite enumeration of true source-boundary overlaps of every valid B/C/D/E local placement

groups.name: opposite_left_unit_anchor
groups.role: A real opposite unit exterior wall fixes the location across the four-cell connector; it is a spatial anchor rather than another piece outline.

groups.name: complete_four_link_step
groups.role: The complete RURU step profile includes both convex end turns and the middle concavity, with all occupied sides correct under the SAME reflection as the opposite wall.

prepared_hypotheses_not_solver_calls.specific_new_information: Two separated source boundary components of4 and1 unit edges fit one D placement under a common rigid map. The opposite wall and the4-link missing-corner stair jointly constrain a four-cell connector plus offset branch, whereas the old E stair alone had no opposite boundary anchor.
prepared_hypotheses_not_solver_calls.difference: D v4 used a contiguous full4-unit top bar and convex end-side; D v7 used two unrelated invariant maps. This uses a single actual placement with a disconnected4+1 shared boundary profile, not a cap/width/color edit of either. Its stair group and far wall are jointly compatible with D and do not fix any internal source cut.
prepared_hypotheses_not_solver_calls.concision: 10 unit-edge styles,5 exact exterior correspondences; each of two components carries a different placement constraint.

groups.name: foot_anchor_three_links
groups.role: Two-unit source wall plus adjacent unit foot are the exact turned image of C short foot end; this is a complete three-link anchor, not the former4-high spine.

groups.name: distant_convex_tip
groups.role: The distant convex unit elbow pins the opposite tip of the same4-cell connector, so the two separated anchors share one exact quarter-turn placement.

prepared_hypotheses_not_solver_calls.specific_new_information: The source left-bottom foot and right missing-corner convex tip fit one transverse C placement. The shared boundary has two components3+2; it is not the contiguous4+2 L of the current C01 or the independent(4,1) signature.
prepared_hypotheses_not_solver_calls.difference: The entire old4-unit source/C spine comparison is removed. A separated opposite tip and a short foot anchor establish a different true boundary-incidence relation under one common rigid map. No imaginary source line connects them.
prepared_hypotheses_not_solver_calls.concision: 10 unit-edge styles,5 exact exterior correspondences in two separated components.

groups.name: first_post_anchor
groups.role: One actual two-cell exterior wall and its unit foot pin the first post of an inverted locally fitting U.

groups.name: second_post_anchor
groups.role: The separate opposite exterior unit elbow pins the second post of the SAME U under the same half-turn; the unmarked source middle bottom cell remains present.

prepared_hypotheses_not_solver_calls.specific_new_information: Two separated post anchors3+2 fit one inverted U. This tests whether a pair of compatible exterior posts is incorrectly promoted to three-copy tileability, while preserving the intervening source cell and not coloring its internal U boundary.
prepared_hypotheses_not_solver_calls.difference: B v3 was a contiguous3-wide base/2-high wall of an upward U. The new shared-edge graph is disconnected3+2 and corresponds to the inverted U with its bottom middle cell OUTSIDE the trial piece but still present in the source. It is not an added cap on the old L, a color change, or the old internal U-notch.
prepared_hypotheses_not_solver_calls.concision: 10 unit-edge styles in two true external anchor components; no source proper closed outline.

rejected_minor_extensions: C maximum7-edge profile is the old contiguous4-high/2-foot profile plus one upper tip edge. That alone is an end-cap extension, so it is not tested as a new hypothesis.

D maximum6-edge straight profile adds the other end-side to the old full-width bar. It supplies no distinct structural comparison beyond that failed bar/anchor and is not tested as a cosmetic extension.
B6-edge outer profile adds one unit side to the old3-by2 L. That small extension alone is not a new information family.
A proposed three-link C reflected step only matched the line curve with the occupied side reversed; it is rejected as a false shape-boundary correspondence.
Lower-edge-count subsets/rotated or relocated copies of an already tested identical profile are not extra hypotheses merely because their PNG changes.
